# Birtingur

Birtingur is a self-service display advertising platform built for long-tail niche content creators (e.g. food, tech, travel, lifestyle blogs) and AI web application developers. Publishers register a site or app, declare content categories, and embed ad slots; advertisers buy by category and budget instead of picking individual sites. The platform spreads impressions across every verified publisher site in that category. All money is in ISK (integer krona, no decimals); Icelandic VAT is 24%.

## Pricing & Payouts

- Flat CPM: 550 ISK per 1,000 impressions, applied across every ad category. No bidding wars or auction volatility.
- No setup fees, no monthly fees. Remaining budget is enforced server-side.
- Publishers and app developers keep 80% of net ad revenue (20% platform fee); payouts run monthly with a 5,000 ISK minimum threshold.
- 100% Cookie-Free: Zero third-party tracking cookies or cross-site profiling. Privacy-first by design.

## MCP Server for AI Agents & App Developers

Birtingur hosts a native Dual-Sided Model Context Protocol (MCP) server at `https://mcp.birtingur.app/`, authenticated via API key (`Authorization: Bearer ak_...`):

### Advertiser & Buying Agent Tools:
- `list_categories`: Fills category names, ID slugs, and live inventory forecasts.
- `list_campaigns`: Returns active and past campaigns for the account.
- `get_campaign`: Detailed performance stats, impressions, and budget burn rate.
- `get_wallet`: Returns current wallet balance and spending limits.
- `create_campaign`: Autonomously purchases category campaigns up to specified spending caps and auto-approval limits.

### Publisher & App Developer Tools:
- `register_publisher`: Registers a new website or AI application.
- `create_slot`: Creates ad placement slots (Leaderboard 728x90, Medium Rectangle 300x250, Mobile 320x100, etc.).
- `list_slots`: Returns all active ad slots and status.
- `get_snippet`: Generates lightweight copy-paste JavaScript embed code.
- `get_react_component`: Returns fully typed React component code (`<BirtingurAdSlot />`) for Next.js and React apps.
- `get_stats`: Hourly impression analytics and earnings stats.
- `set_content_policy`: Configures category blocking rules for a site.
